summary.text: Peter Abbarno is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 20-Position 1 since January 11, 2021, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Abbarno earned a bachelor's degree from the State University of New York at Fredonia in 1997, a J.D. from Vermont Law School in 2008, and an L.L.M. in taxation from the University of Washington School of Law in 2009.
His career experience includes working as an attorney.

In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, Abbarno described himself as a small business owner, attorney and mayor pro tem of Centralia, said he was elected to the Centralia City Council in 2015 and re-elected in 2019, and said he was president of the Centralia College Foundation.
He took office in the House in January 2021 and, during the 2023-2024 session, was assigned to the Capital Budget, Environment & Energy, and Labor and Workplace Standards committees.
In the 2026 general election he faces Democrat Andy Zahn; Abbarno received 65.0 percent of the vote in the August 4 primary.
